title: xi cutscene cast (NPCs)
description: Cast list for one cutscene: NPCs that appear, their initial stage positions/headings, and optional look overrides. The compiler emits a 0xBA calibrate_entity_position for each entry with a pos/dir before the scene proper begins; visibility becomes 0x4E render-flag toggles at showFrame/hideFrame.

id.description: Stable cast id (e.g. 'maat', 'player', 'daswil'). Referenced from steps as 'actor'/'target'/'speaker'.

entity.description: Server entity id (0x01000000 + (zone<<12) + idx). Symbolic aliases: 'player' (0x7FFFFFF0), 'event_entity' (0x7FFFFFF8), party/alliance slot magic ids.

name.description: Human label — for editor/logs only, not written to DAT.

pos.description: Initial FFXI world position [x, y, z]. Compiler encodes as int(v*1000) into references[]. Y is height.

dir.description: Initial facing heading in radians (FFXI convention). Compiler encodes as int(v*1000). Same axis as opcode 0xBA.

look.description: Optional 20-byte look blob override (equipped gear + face/race). If absent, look is resolved from server npc_list at build time.

showFrame.description: Playhead frame to reveal this NPC (emits 0x4E show). Default: visible from t=0.

hideFrame.description: Playhead frame to hide this NPC (emits 0x4E hide). Default: visible until scene end.
